name: Switch Subscription Leg
definition: Subscription leg, or switch-in, of a switch order.

PercentageOfTotalRedemptionAmount.name: Percentage Of Total Redemption Amount
PercentageOfTotalRedemptionAmount.definition: Percentage of the total redemption amount used for the subscription in an investment fund or investment fund class.

SubscriptionRelatedSwitchOrder.name: Subscription Related Switch Order
SubscriptionRelatedSwitchOrder.definition: Switch order to which the subscription leg refers.
